summary: Press-and-hold generate button: pixels spiral in as a ring fills, and release fires a shockwave sized to the charge, one to four variations.

events.name: generate
events.description: Fires on release after a long enough hold. `count` is 1 to 4 variations; `charge` is the fill level from 0 to 1, rounded to two decimals.

methods.description: Begins charging, as if the button were pressed. Ignored while charging or during the 2.4 seconds after a release fires.
Ends charging. Below 18% it shows "Hold longer" and fires nothing; otherwise it fires `generate`.

keyboard.action: Charge while held; releasing the key fires. Moving focus away mid-hold cancels without firing.

accessibility: The control is a native button whose text follows the charge ("Hold to generate", "Charging…", "Keep holding…") and then reports the result ("N variations ready").
The line below the button is an `aria-live="polite"` region that reports the charge level after firing.
The canvas is decorative and has `aria-hidden="true"`.
motion: With reduced motion, the button does not tremble or pop and no particles spiral in; spark bursts are skipped, while the ring fill and shockwave still draw.
notes: A full charge takes 1.6 seconds. The variation count is the charge times four, rounded, with a minimum of one.
